{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Reflective songwriting fits my interests, but I would choose a blues album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Cheek to Cheek; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal jazz standards are outside my current blues and classic-rock mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues guitar feels like a natural next listen after Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels.
ItemID: NA; Title: Led Zeppelin IV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-rooted rock appeals to me, but I am more interested in discovering another release today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets: Re-Working The Catalogue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful reinterpretations could fit my interest in Memphis, though this is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ride Out; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented rock suits my recent listening, but I would sample it another time.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Christopher Cross Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for seasonal music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: New; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Melodic rock connects with my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I am choosing blues today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Pet Sounds Stereo Remasters; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its orchestrated pop sound is less relevant to my current interest in blues and roots rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: Life Journey; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots and soulful feel sound promising, but I would keep this visit to one selection."}
